title: 艹 grass (草字头)
intro: 艹 sits on top and is written in three strokes: horizontal, short vertical, short vertical. Characters with 艹 are usually plants, herbs, vegetables, flowers, or things made from them (tea, medicine).

ex.p: qǐng bù yào zài cǎo dì shǎng zǒu
ex.en: Please don't walk on the grass.

ex.zh: 她每天花很多时间学英语。
ex.p: tā měi tiān huā hěn duō shí jiān xué yīng yǔ
ex.en: She spends a lot of time studying English every day.

ex.p: wǒ gěi mā ma mǎi le yī xiē huā
ex.en: I bought some flowers for my mom.

ex.p: gōng yuán lǐ de huā dōu kāi le
ex.en: The flowers in the park have all bloomed.

ex.p: nǐ hē chá hái shi hē kā fēi
ex.en: Do you drink tea or coffee?

ex.zh: 很多中国人喜欢喝绿茶。
ex.p: hěn duō zhōng guó rén xǐ huan hē lǜ chá
ex.en: Many Chinese people like green tea.

ex.p: fú wù yuán wǒ men yào diǎn cài
ex.en: Waiter, we'd like to order.

ex.p: nǐ xǐ huan chī zhōng guó cài ma
ex.en: Do you like Chinese food?

ex.zh: 感冒了就去药店买点儿药。
ex.p: gǎn mào le jiù qù yào diàn mǎi diǎn ér yào
ex.en: If you catch a cold, go buy some medicine at the pharmacy.

ex.p: zhè gè yào hěn kǔ
ex.en: This medicine is very bitter.

ex.p: wǒ mǎi le yī jīn píng guǒ
ex.en: I bought a jin (half a kilo) of apples.

ex.zh: 她每天花很多时间学英语。
ex.p: tā měi tiān huā hěn duō shí jiān xué yīng yǔ
ex.en: She spends a lot of time studying English every day.

ex.p: tā de yīng yǔ hěn hǎo
ex.en: Her English is very good.

ex.zh: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
ex.p: chūn jié shì zhōng guó zuì zhòng yào de jié rì
ex.en: Spring Festival is China's most important holiday.

ex.zh: 你最喜欢哪个电视节目？
ex.p: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ gè diàn shì jié mù
ex.en: Which TV show do you like best?

ex.zh: 你工作太辛苦了，休息一下吧。
ex.p: nǐ gōng zuò tài xīn kǔ le xiū xi yī xià ba
ex.en: You work too hard, take a rest.

ex.p: zhè gè yào hěn kǔ
ex.en: This medicine is very bitter.

ex.p: fēi jī kuài yào jiàng luò le
ex.en: The plane is about to land.

ex.zh: 秋天到了，树叶都落下来了。
ex.p: qiū tiān dào le shù yè dōu luò xià lái le
ex.en: Autumn has come, the leaves have all fallen.

ex.p: tiān kōng shì lán sè de
ex.en: The sky is blue.

ex.zh: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
ex.p: tā zài bǐ sài zhōng huò dé le dì yī míng
ex.en: He won first place in the competition.

ex.p: jīn nián de shōu huò hěn dà
ex.en: This year's harvest was big.

茶.h: 艹 + 人 + 木 (a plant someone picks)

texts.title: 读一读 · 艹 grass (草字头)

lines.zh: 妈妈去花店买了很多红花，爸爸去市场买了苹果和很多菜。
lines.p: mā ma qù huā diàn mǎi le hěn duō hóng huā bà ba qù shì chǎng mǎi le píng guǒ hé hěn duō cài

lines.zh: 奶奶在家里做饭，我在旁边帮她。
lines.p: nǎi nai zài jiā lǐ zuò fàn wǒ zài páng biān bāng tā

lines.zh: 我们一家人一起喝茶、吃饭、看电视节目。
lines.p: wǒ men yī jiā rén yī qǐ hē chá chī fàn kàn diàn shì jié mù

lines.zh: 春节是我最喜欢的节日。
lines.p: chūn jié shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de jié rì

qs.q: 爸爸在哪儿买了苹果和菜？

exercises.q: 春节是中国最重要的节目。
exercises.ans: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
exercises.why: 节目 = show; 节日 = holiday
菜 and 茶 share 艹 on top
若 (ruò) has 右 under the grass
篮 (basket) has bamboo 竹 on top

exercises.q: 她每天化很多时间学英语。
exercises.ans: 她每天花很多时间学英语。
exercises.why: 化 is only the sound part

exercises.zh: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
exercises.p: chūn jié shì zhōng guó zuì zhòng yào de jié rì
exercises.en: Spring Festival is China's most important holiday.

exercises.zh: 你工作太辛苦了，休息一下吧。
exercises.p: nǐ gōng zuò tài xīn kǔ le xiū xi yī xià ba
exercises.en: You work too hard, take a rest.

exercises.zh: 感冒了就去药店买点儿药。
exercises.p: gǎn mào le jiù qù yào diàn mǎi diǎn ér yào
exercises.en: If you catch a cold, go buy some medicine at the pharmacy.

exercises.p: fú wù yuán wǒ men yào diǎn cài
